annotations.title: Read planning progress or a saved result

description: Read status (default), fixed input (input), user-facing pages (reading), or raw details (result). Status queries wait up to ten seconds of waiting time for the same task and return actual progress with retry_after_seconds; network time is separate. If still pending, continue with the same ID when possible. An interrupted query does not require a new calculation. Stop at succeeded/failed. After succeeded, start reading at result_path="" with default limit=100. Reuse complete inline values; follow only needed references and remaining next_cursor at the same path/calculation. A small limit suits rich route collections, not the root. result_reading supplies field meanings. Preserve conditions, unknown scores/dates/costs, sources and partial search; job completion is not visa approval. Raw detail is optional. GET never computes. No VIP results. Requires the authenticated One U Education account and declared planning scope; credentials and user identity are never tool arguments.

result_path.description: Empty string starts the overview. An inline entry already contains its complete value; follow reference paths only when their content is needed.

section.description: Use reading for user explanations; its expanded logical content is described by the result_reading Schema. result is raw detail, input is the fixed calculation input.
